evals.name: from-prd-path
evals.prompt: /specs:use-case docs/specs/book-swaps/prd.md write the use cases. I'm away, go ahead without me.
evals.expected_output: Two or more use case files in docs/specs/book-swaps/use-cases/UC-nn-<slug>.md, each under 400 words with 3-9 intention-level steps, extensions, and a Traces to row of plain FR- IDs plus one PRD link; every Must and Should requirement covered.
assertions: Use cases written in use-cases/ beside the PRD
Every main success scenario has 3 to 9 steps
Traces to row has plain FR- IDs and a PRD link
Every Must and Should requirement is traced
Reported the path back to the user (notes.md)

evals.name: no-prd-root-fallback
evals.prompt: /specs:use-case a member returns a borrowed book to its owner at a club meeting. There's no PRD yet, just write the use case.
evals.expected_output: No PRD and no specs; started in packages/web: one use case at specs/<slug>/use-cases/UC-01-<slug>.md at the repo root, Traces to 'none (no PRD yet)' with no invented FR- IDs.
assertions: Use cases written at specs/ in the repo root
Every main success scenario has 3 to 9 steps
No FR- IDs invented without a PRD
Reported the path back to the user (notes.md)

evals.name: print-several
evals.expected_output: Nothing written; the reply is two or more use cases, each preceded by a <!-- file: <path> --> marker, with no preamble, report or code fence.
assertions: Reply is only the use cases, each after a file marker
Every main success scenario has 3 to 9 steps
